name: Binance BTC/USDT one-, ten-, and thirty-second momentum
description: Causal simple basis-point returns of the fresh Binance displayed best-quote midpoint over one, ten, and thirty one-second observations. direction_10s is down, flat, or up from the full-precision ten-second return. Any missing or stale one-second Binance midpoint observation breaks continuity and restarts the 30-second warm-up. This identity is single-venue: it reads only Binance inputs and is ready whenever the Binance midpoint ring holds at least 31 contiguous one-second samples, independently of the other adopted spot venue. The blended `btc.external.*` reading of the same measurement stays the reference layer and continues to require every adopted venue (ADR 0024). Decimal outputs are rounded to eight places using round-half-to-even. Venue port (B1): this identity is the Binance sibling of `btc.coinbase.micro_momentum@1.0.0` and reuses that definition's formulas, windows, thresholds, warm-up, staleness bound, field set, field types and eight-place round-half-to-even rounding verbatim; only the source ids differ (`crates/btc-signals/src/spot_signals.rs`, `crates/btc-signals/src/candidate_spot_signals.rs`). The instrument is Binance spot BTCUSDT; this identity publishes no price-level field, so its outputs (base sizes, basis points, imbalances, ratios, counts) are quote-currency neutral and nothing is converted. Binance inputs are rights-gated (`signals/knowledge/RIGHTS-LEDGER.md`): the lane is built and tested to the adopted standard, and its runtime refuses to start unless the environment allow-list `SIGNALS_ENABLED_VENUES` names `binance`, which the deployment sets only after that row clears. The Binance midpoint input is the `btcusdt@bookTicker` stream, a scalar best bid and ask; the one-second midpoint is (bid plus ask) divided by two sampled once per second. It carries no venue clock, so `event_time_basis` is `receipt`. quote_currency is emitted on every decision and is the constant "usd" for this venue: this identity publishes no price-denominated field — its outputs are base sizes, ratios, basis-point and count fields, all quote-currency neutral — so nothing is converted. Wire contract status (E45b): this identity reads only binance.spot.btcusdt.book-ticker, whose live payload was absent from the wave-A capture; its contract, documented ahead of observation, is now observed and confirmed against a fresh gated Binance spot capture (binance-spot-r2-20260903T235740Z, 2026-09-03, 454344 `btcusdt@bookTicker` frames carrying the u/s/b/B/a/A best-quote fields and no engine timestamp). E47 (USD quoting): this identity quotes in USD and publishes no price, notional or quote-denominated cost field — its outputs are base sizes, counts, basis-point ratios and durations, which are quote-currency neutral — so nothing is converted and no usdt_usd_rate is published. quote_currency is the constant "usd".
